name: pulse-dashboard
description: Codex-hosted Pulse health and training dashboard companion for an already connected COROS MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Turn connected COROS MCP data into a Pulse desktop dashboard.
interface.longDescription: Pulse uses the COROS MCP service already connected in Codex to create a sanitized health and training snapshot, AI coaching insight, and a local desktop dashboard update. It includes compact 16:9, 4:3, and 21:9 widget layouts; it does not access COROS directly or manage credentials.
defaultPrompt: 刷新我的 Pulse 今日健康与训练快照。
根据我最新的 COROS 数据，给出明日训练建议。
复盘我今天的训练，并更新 Pulse 洞察。
